title: Love Is Patient and Kind
summary: Love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care. Love in 1 Corinthians is patient, kind, and not self-centered. When relationships get annoying, this passage turns love into real choices, not just a feeling.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Corinthians 13:1-13. Watch for what the story shows about love.

tell_it: Love in 1 Corinthians is patient, kind, and not self-centered. In the story, Paul taught that impressive gifts are empty without love. Real love is patient, kind, humble, and lasting.
understand_it: The point is not that love Is Patient and Kind is impressive by itself. Love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care. When relationships get annoying, this passage turns love into real choices, not just a feeling.
age_5_7_explanation: Love in 1 Corinthians is patient, kind, and not self-centered.
age_8_11_explanation: Paul taught that impressive gifts are empty without love. Real love is patient, kind, humble, and lasting. Ages 8-11 can name the Bible detail in Love Is Patient and Kind and the takeaway: love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care.
teen_explanation: Love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care. For teens, the lesson is worth discussing honestly because it connects belief with public choices, private motives, and costly obedience.
key_truths: Love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care.
Love Is Patient and Kind shows love through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When relationships get annoying, this passage turns love into real choices, not just a feeling.
life_application: When relationships get annoying, this passage turns love into real choices, not just a feeling.

quiz_questions.question: In this lesson about love, which answer matches the Bible story?
choices: Paul says love is only words
quiz_questions.explanation: Patient and kind fits the actual event in Love Is Patient and Kind. The wrong answers may sound possible in another story, but not this one.

quiz_questions.question: What is one wise response to Love Is Patient and Kind?
quiz_questions.answer: When relationships get annoying, this passage turns love into real choices, not just a feeling.
quiz_questions.explanation: The lesson should move from hearing to response. Love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care.

discussion_questions: Retell Love Is Patient and Kind in three beats: setup, hard moment, and response.

activity.title: Love Looks Like Cards
activity.instructions: Write patient, kind, humble, and forgiving on cards, then act out what each one looks like.

prayer_prompt: God, show me where Love Is Patient and Kind touches my own life, and help me respond with honesty, courage, and obedience.
